mapper.sql: r.*, a.name AS account_name, a.provider, m.owh_code, w.name AS warehouse_name, s.name AS store_name

FROM ecom_owh_return r JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = r.account_id LEFT JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.id = r.mapping_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = r.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = r.store_id

sql.if: AND (r.return_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.owh_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.ecom_return_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.tracking_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT r.status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM ecom_owh_return r
GROUP BY r.status
SELECT * FROM ecom_owh_return WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT er.id AS "id", er.doc_no AS "docNo", er.platform_order_no AS "platformOrderNo", s.name AS "storeName", w.name AS "warehouseName", er.reason AS "reason", er.create_time AS "createTime" FROM ecom_return er JOIN ecom_owh_warehouse m ON m.warehouse_id = er.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = er.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = er.warehouse_id WHERE er.return_type = 'RETURN_REFUND' AND er.status = 'PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ecom_owh_return x WHERE x.ecom_return_id = er.id AND x.status <> 'CANCELLED')
AND (er.doc_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR er.platform_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY er.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT r.id FROM ecom_owh_return r JOIN ecom_owh_account a ON a.id = r.account_id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.auto_sync = 1 AND (r.status = 'PUSHED' OR (r.status = 'RECEIVED' AND r.erp_received = 0)) ORDER BY r.id
